entity: Red River Parish LA area earthquakes: none M2.5+ 2010-2023, 29 since Jan 2024, topped by the M4.9
what_we_add: The zero-quake 2010-2023 baseline for the box and the 29-event count since Jan 2024
why: Tulane, the Advocate, the state agency and KTBS all name Red River Parish and report the same finding: an unusual new quake series capped by the March 5 M4.9, cause under investigation. No source states our box's zero 2010-2023 baseline or the 29 count; the Advocate's 35-since-2022 covers all of northwestern Louisiana, a wider area, so it doesn't contradict the box numbers.
